name: Punish Defiance AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A magical mural threatens uncooperative inmates, causing mental trauma.
disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) to deactivate the mural, or DC 26 Arcana (trained) to disrupt the mural's magic, or DC 24 Deception (trained) to pose as a superior and order the mural to deactivate, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the mural
routine: (1 action) On its turn, the trap threatens all living creatures in the room, dealing (3d6+5) Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Will Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Final Warning
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature defies the prison's authority (such as by attacking a clockwork soldier or living graffiti)

Effect The mural commands the inmate to cease their defiance and surrender to authority. All living creatures in the room must attempt a DC 24 Will Saving Throw save, becoming Frightened 1 and Stupefied 1 on a failure, or Frightened 2 and Stupefied 2 on a critical failure. The trap then rolls initiative.
